competency.title: Operate and prove a building's boiler, chiller and fire-protection plant

completionRule: every station has a passing attempt (stars >= 2, no unsafe action)

ladder.note: a lesson is one station step under one condition; see docs/ladders.md

name: Stationary Engineer — Building Plant

stations.why: Start-up and purge: the sequence that stops a furnace explosion.
Refrigerant, isolation and the machine that is the building's whole cooling capacity.
The Legionella task: the tower is the one plant that can make the neighbourhood sick.
The annual flow test, where the curve either matches the nameplate or the building has no fire protection.
The pit: a confined space with a moving car above it, entered by the person who maintains it.
The annual survey down the steam main, where a blow-through is read from the trap itself and the swap is made only once the line is actually locked out.
The queue at shift start, where the panel's own arc-flash label and a lockout come before a breaker reset, and a buried freeze-stat alarm never gets scrolled past.

summary: The four plants a building engineer is responsible for at two in the morning, and the tests that prove each one will work when it is needed.
union: IUOE — International Union of Operating Engineers, stationary locals
